title: [Email - Outlook REST API] Skip attachments without contentBytes in RetrieveEmails
summary: The Email - Outlook REST API connector now skips attachments without contentBytes instead of failing the entire batch, allowing emails with non-file attachments to be imported successfully.
key_points: Attachments without contentBytes (item and reference attachments) are now skipped instead of causing batch failure
File attachments with contentBytes continue to work unchanged
Unhandled JSON parsing errors that rolled back entire email batches are eliminated
Regression test added with test payload for non-file attachments
